title: Burfi - 7 cups
description: The foolproof traditional festive sweet crafted using 7 proportionate measures of gram flour, dry fruits, fresh coconut, milk, sugar, and golden ghee.

steps.instruction: Make a coarse powder of cashews, almonds, and cardamom in a small mixer jar.
Add besan to a heavy-bottomed kadai and dry roast on low flame until nutty and aromatic.
Add powdered dry fruit mix, sugar, milk, and grated coconut while stirring continuously to prevent lumps.
After 1 minute, pour in the melted ghee.
Keep stirring on medium-low flame. The mixture will darken slightly, then fluff up and bubble as the ghee separates.
When the texture becomes light, porous, and halwa-like, take it off heat immediately.
Pour into a pre-greased tray or thali. Cut into neat diamond squares after it partially sets.

storyOrOrigin: A classic grandmother recipe where a single glass or cup is used to measure every single ingredient with zero guesswork.
grandmasSecrets: Fluffy and bubbly = Ready. The mix will feel light like a cloud on your ladle.
Use a single small tumbler or cup as the standard measure for all 7 portions.
